question: Extend the line-6 false-negative screen beyond NTEE T30/T31/T70 and DAF-like names: full-text screen (Schedule D Part I values plus DAF-holding language) of the newest FY2022+ 990 of every other 501(c)(3) filer with total assets of at least $1m that answers Part IV line 6 'No', then confirm the 13 sponsor candidates (Groundswell, DEED, Visit.org, Caring Communities, Impact France and 8 'possible') from their websites, donor agreements and next returns
